name: rutter
description: A record of what your AI sessions decided, and the receipts behind it. Search your markdown notes and recall what past sessions decided, all on your own machine.

vault_path.title: Notes folder
vault_path.description: The folder of markdown notes rutter should search (an Obsidian vault works). rutter reads it, and keeps its session records in a _librarian/ folder inside it.

user_label.title: Your name (optional)
user_label.description: How rutter refers to whose work this is when it talks to Claude, for example "Sam". Leave as is if you prefer a neutral wording.
